name: Exp_XMA_Range_Channel
summary: This EA trades breakouts from the XMA_Range_Channel indicator, opening buy positions when price breaks above the upper channel and sell positions when it breaks below the lower channel. It uses configurable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) for the channel calculation and includes money management, stop loss, and take profit controls. Signal filtering is done via a color buffer system from the custom indicator.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XMA_Range_Channel指标进行通道突破交易，价格突破上轨时开多仓，突破下轨时开空仓。支持多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA等）计算通道，并包含资金管理、止损止盈控制。信号过滤通过自定义指标的颜色缓冲区系统实现。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XMA_Range_Channel指标的通道突破交易。入场条件方面，当指标的颜色缓冲区（buffer 8）值大于1时产生买入信号，同时前一值小于2或为空值时确认突破上轨开多仓；当颜色缓冲区值小于2且不为空值时产生卖出信号，前一值大于1或为空值时确认突破下轨开空仓。出场条件方面，买入信号触发时同时平掉卖仓，卖出信号触发时同时平掉买仓，此外还有独立的止损和止盈设置（默认止损1000点，止盈2000点）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准函数，支持按自由保证金、余额、减去亏损后的余额或固定手数等多种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），配合MMMode选择资金管理模式。该策略使用SignalBar参数允许在第1根已收盘K线上检测信号，避免未完成K线的虚假信号，同时通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a channel breakout system based on the XMA_Range_Channel indicator. For entry conditions, when the indicator's color buffer (buffer 8) value exceeds 1, a buy signal is generated, and if the previous value is below 2 or empty, it confirms an upper channel breakout for a long position. Conversely, when the color buffer value is below 2 and not empty, a sell signal is generated, with the previous value above 1 or empty confirming a lower channel breakout for a short position. For exit conditions, a buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of sell positions, and a sell signal triggers closing of buy positions, supplemented by independent stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points) settings. Position sizing uses standard functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, supporting multiple modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot sizing. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter (default 0.1 risk ratio) combined with the MMMode selector for the margin calculation method. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter to detect signals on the 1st completed bar, avoiding false signals from incomplete bars, and employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter for lot calculation

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/减亏损余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin / balance / margin after loss / balance after loss / fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测交易信号的K线索引（0=当前K线，1=已收盘K线）

pros: 使用已收盘K线（SignalBar=1）检测信号，避免未完成K线产生的虚假信号
支持10种平滑算法，灵活性高，可根据不同市场特性选择最优算法
内置完整的资金管理系统，支持多种仓位计算模式，风险可控
通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓
买卖开关独立控制，可以灵活配置为只做多、只做空或双向交易
pros_en: Uses completed bar (SignalBar=1) for signal detection, avoiding false signals from incomplete bars
Supports 10 smoothing algorithms with high flexibility to match different market characteristics
Built-in complete money management system with multiple position sizing modes for controllable risk
IsNewBar mechanism ensures signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries
Independent buy/sell toggle controls allow flexible configuration for long-only, short-only, or bidirectional trading
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，可能在波动较大的品种上造成较大亏损
没有持仓检查机制，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
通道突破策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假突破信号，导致连续亏损
依赖自定义指标XMA_Range_Channel的buffer 8颜色值，逻辑不够透明，难以验证信号正确性
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在点差较大或流动性差的时段可能不利
cons_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large, potentially causing significant losses on volatile instruments
No position check mechanism - may open duplicate positions in the same direction when already holding
Channel breakout strategies tend to generate frequent false breakout signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Relies on custom indicator XMA_Range_Channel buffer 8 color values - logic is opaque and difficult to verify signal correctness
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may cause unfavorable entries during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，并增加最大持仓数限制
添加点差过滤和交易时段控制，在点差过大或非主要交易时段禁止开仓
增加移动止损或追踪止损功能，在盈利时锁定利润
添加ADX或波动率过滤，在震荡行情中减少虚假突破信号
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate same-direction entries and implement maximum position count limits
Add spread filter and trading session controls to prohibit entries during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Implement trailing stop functionality to lock in profits when trades move favorably
Add ADX or volatility filter to reduce false breakout signals during ranging market conditions

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查，可能同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
默认止损1000点较大，单笔亏损可能较高
通道突破在震荡市中容易产生连续虚假信号导致多次止损
没有点差过滤，高波动时点差扩大可能造成额外损失
risk_points_en: No position check may cause duplicate same-direction entries leading to overexposure
Default 1000-point stop loss is large, potentially resulting in high per-trade losses
Channel breakout in ranging markets easily generates consecutive false signals causing multiple stop-outs
No spread filter means widened spreads during high volatility may cause additional losses
